title: Quantum-to-semiclassical Husimi dynamics of non-Hermitian localization transitions
summary: The localization transition in the Hermitian Aubry-André model is known to have a clear classical origin, with the critical point being exactly predictable from an analysis of classical phase-space trajectories. Motivated by this correspondence, we investigate whether a similar classical origin exists for localization transitions in non-Hermitian quasiperiodic Hamiltonians. Using semiclassical Husimi dynamics together with a detailed phase-space stability analysis, we show that localization transitions persist even in the semiclassical limit of such non-Hermitian models.
